ModMetadata.Name: ScriptedScreens Fonts [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ScriptedScreens Fonts[/h1] [i]Client-side only. Nothing on disk is modified.[/i]
Real typefaces on your consoles. Use the game's own fonts and any [b].ttf[/b] or [b].otf[/b] file by name in a [b]ScriptedScreens[/b] label, with the standard TextMeshPro tag:
[code]props = { text = '<font="Barlow Condensed">TANK 3 84%' }[/code]
Ships with the [b]Barlow[/b] and [b]Barlow Condensed[/b] families, every weight from Thin to Black with italics.
[h2]Why it is needed[/h2] Stationeers loads its fonts from asset bundles, where TextMeshPro's name lookup never finds them, so a [b]<font>[/b] tag errors out. This mod registers them directly, and builds new fonts from the files in its folder. There is no Lua API: the tag simply works, in every label, and ScriptedScreens is not patched.
[h2]Your own fonts[/h2] [list] [*] Drop font files anywhere under [b]mods/ScriptedScreensFonts/Assets/fonts[/b]; subfolders are fine [*] The name is the font's own: [b]Barlow-Bold.ttf[/b] is [b]<font="Barlow Bold">[/b], [b]Barlow-Regular.ttf[/b] is [b]<font="Barlow">[/b] [*] Every file has an on/off switch in the mod settings, grouped by family; a switched-off font costs no memory [*] Restart the game after adding a file or changing a switch [*] Ship the font's licence with it; the included Barlow files are SIL Open Font License 1.1 [/list]
[h2]Characters[/h2] Each font is built once with printable ASCII, Latin-1 (accents, ° ± µ ² ³) and common UI symbols: dashes and curly quotes, − ≈ ≠ ≤ ≥ ∞ √ Δ π Ω, arrows, shapes, block bars and box drawing. Add more in the [b]ExtraCharacters[/b] setting. A character the font file does not contain is left out rather than drawn from another typeface; Barlow, for example, has no arrows.
[h2]Getting started[/h2] Everything is in the mod folder ([i]Documents/My Games/Stationeers/mods/ScriptedScreensFonts[/i]): [list] [*] [b]examples/[/b] -- four scripts that each run on paste: a font tag, every weight, a name check, a live readout [*] [b]QUICKSTART.md[/b] -- one page: a label that runs as written, the mistakes that fail silently, a symptom-to-cause table [*] [b]README.md[/b] -- the guide [*] [b]CHANGELOG.md[/b] -- the full release history [/list] Every available font name is written to [b]BepInEx/LogOutput.log[/b] ("Font available:"). Names are case sensitive; a wrong name prints its tag literally. The same files are [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts]on GitHub[/url].
[h2]AI editor support (MCP)[/h2] With [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3659911735]StationeersLua[/url] installed, an AI editor connected to its MCP server can read: [list] [*] [b]stationeers://fonts/index[/b] -- a brief written for AI: a label that runs as written, the rules that fail silently, and a map of every other page [*] [b]stationeers://fonts/available[/b] -- every font name registered right now, and where it came from [*] the guide one searchable page per section (search scope [b]fonts[/b]), the changelog and the four examples [/list] Nothing changes without StationeersLua; the mod works the same.
[h2]Notes[/h2] [list] [*] Some of the game's own fonts make Unity log an error every frame when used in a label; the mod names them in the log and in the MCP list [*] Each font file costs about 1 MB of texture memory; switch off the weights you do not use [*] The game's own fonts keep arriving for the first minutes of a session [*] [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-html]ScriptedScreens Html[/url] uses these fonts by the same names in CSS [/list]
[h2]Changelog[/h2] [b]0.2.0[/b] [list] [*] [b]Your own fonts.[/b] .ttf and .otf files under Assets/fonts become fonts named from their own metadata; Barlow and Barlow Condensed included. [*] An on/off switch per font file in the mod settings, grouped by family. [*] A fixed character set per font with common UI symbols, extendable with ExtraCharacters. [*] [b]MCP support for AI editors[/b]: a quick start, the live font list, the guide, the changelog and the examples. [*] examples/, QUICKSTART.md and CHANGELOG.md ship in the mod folder. [/list] [b]0.1.0[/b] [list] [*] The game's own fonts are usable by name in ScriptedScreens labels. [/list]
[h2]Source[/h2] [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts]github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts[/url] — MIT licensed. The bundled fonts keep their own licence (SIL OFL 1.1). Issues and pull requests welcome.
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [*] [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666779631]ScriptedScreens[/url] — to use the fonts on consoles [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3659911735]StationeersLua[/url] — optional, for the MCP documentation [/list]
